name: Linearly Separable Piecewise Polynomial Interpolation Gradient
aliases: Gradient Estimation via Gradient Filters, Linearly separable filter
definition: A gradient estimation method using optimized piecewise polynomial interpolation filters designed for specific accuracy and continuity characteristics, proposed by Möller et al.
summary: This method estimates 3D volume gradients using optimized linearly separable filters, distinguished by performing only one interpolation step per component for higher quality illumination results.
